rule: Reverse-charge treatment applies to a narrow category of construction-adjacent services distinct from the standard-rate default - verified against a documented ruling not a general assumption.
Intra-group cost-sharing invoices below a documented internal threshold carry a reduced evidence requirement - a narrower documentation bar than third-party services of the same category.

Cross-border services from EU suppliers to Northgate's French entity: absent an explicit intra-group designation in the underlying contract resolves as a fully recoverable taxable third-party supply not a restricted intra-group charge.

Cleanroom or R&D-facility equipment purchases booked to cost center 4520-series are fully recoverable under Germany's R&D equipment tax treatment even when the SAP line description is generic (e.g. Project Tools) - verify via the underlying contract's facility designation not the SAP line description alone.
